### **Corporate Objectives**

1. To provide quality educational programs in an inclusive space where diverse individuals can learn, collaborate, and create together.  
2. To assist the community by providing a safe, fun, and educational Makerspace for adult and child STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics) and Art Education.  
3. To make donations for the public welfare, or for community funds, charitable, educational, scientific, and civic purposes.

## **Club Descriptions**

All Clubs are adults only (unless otherwise specified). Clubs give Makers an opportunity to meet likeminded makers, collaborate, and learn in a less structured environment than a class or workshop.

* Cosplay Club  
  * Mondays: 7 PM \- 9 PM  
  * Host: Max  
  * Club President: Casey  
  * Join the Cosplay Club and dive into a world of imagination and creativity\! We're a community of cosplayers who share a passion for bringing beloved characters to life.  
    * Share your cosplay journey: Learn from others' experiences and get inspired by their creations.  
    * Develop your skills: Learn new techniques, from prop making to wig styling, with hands-on workshops.  
    * Connect with fellow cosplayers: Build friendships, collaborate on group cosplays, and attend conventions together.  
* Creative Teens Club  
  * Wednesdays 4pm-7pm  
  * Host: Star   
  * **Creative Teens Club** gives young makers, tinkerers, and artists (ages 11–17) a welcoming space to be authentically themselves, follow their curiosity, and build hands-on self-reliance. Free from rigid adult curriculums, teens take the lead with full access to our makerspace—whether they’re 3D printing, laser cutting, crafting jewelry, sewing cosplay, or diving into D\&D and illustration. Supported by peers and experienced mentors, it’s a community where teens connect, collaborate, and create on their own terms.  
* Drawing and Storytelling Club  
  * Wednesdays: 7 PM \- 9 PM  
  * Club President: Annabella  
  * Whether you're developing your latest graphic novel, scripting an indie pilot, detailing your favorite OC’s (Original Character) backstory, or just craving a chill evening of doodling with fellow creators, this is your creative home. Join us every Wednesday night to connect, collaborate, and bring your stories to life in our supportive maker community. Included with Full Membership or Club Membership (\$30/mo); Day Passes welcome (\$25).  
* Electronics Club  
  * Thursdays: 7 PM to 9 PM  
  * Club President: Bob  
  * Join our Electronics Club and dive into the world of circuits, microcontrollers, and DIY projects. Work with other maker to build robots, learn about new tech, and make amazing projects together.  
* Process Art Club  
  * Sundays: 1 PM \- 3 PM  
  * Social Medium’s Process Art club meets every Sunday to engage creatively and foster authentic social connection. Process Art Club is for anybody who enjoys deep conversation, self-reflection, and creative exploration. While we are a group that meets weekly, newcomers are always welcome to try it out and (hopefully come back\!)   
  * Faccilitator: Ilana   
  * Club President: Christine  
    * **Typical Agenda:**   
    * Check in  
    * Warm up  
    * Prompted One-on-one discussion  
    * Creative exploration (about 40 minutes of art-making)  
    * Witness writing  
    * Witness reading   
    * Logistics and closing  
  *   
* TTRPG Club (D\&D)  
  * Sundays: 4 PM \- 6 PM  
  * Club President: Jacob M  
  * Come play Dungeons and Dragons and other role Table-Top Playing Games

## 

## **Special Events**

### **Maker Melee**

Join us for a fun and creative night of crafting and silliness. In this competition show-style event teams of Makers design and create a ridiculous invention or art piece and then pitch it to the audience and judges for prizes and glory\!

### **Show and Tell**

Join us for a night of inspiration and innovation at the Social Medium Show and Tell night\! Share your latest projects, discoveries, and creative endeavors with the maker community. Whether you've built a robot, crafted a masterpiece, or uncovered a fascinating fact, we want to hear about it\!

This is your chance to showcase your talents, get feedback, and connect with like-minded individuals. Bring your prototypes, finished products, or just your ideas to share. 

Or come to see our Featured Presenters:  Makers at the forefront of their fields form Robotics to Animation to Science.

### **Workshops**

Learn new skills from Laser cutting to sewing to 3d Printing to Stained Glass.

### **Halloween Party**

Get ready for a night of frights, flights, and supernatural delights at our highly anticipated annual Halloween Party\! Join us for an evening filled with haunting beats from our live DJ, mind-bending live magic performances, and a spectacular costume contest featuring epic prizes. When you need a break from the dance floor, you can explore our Artist Alley to browse amazing works from local creators, or fuel up on food and drinks.

### **Gallery Night**

In this fundraising event, we invite artists to sell their art with a portion of the proceeds going to help Support Social Medium. We also have a fun Raffle or Auction.

# **Community Guidelines & Code of Conduct**

## **In-Person Guidelines**

1. **Respect Others:** Social Medium has zero tolerance for discrimination. Any form of racism, ableism, homophobia, transphobia, or sexism is strictly prohibited. Individuals who do not follow this rule will be asked to leave. If you accidentally offend someone, prioritize impact over intent and do what you can to make it right.  
2. **Respect The Space:** Take care of the tools and materials you use. Clean up after yourself and notify staff immediately when something breaks or needs replacement.  
3. **Ask For Help:** No experts here\! Can’t figure something out, don’t know where to start on a project, or don’t understand a reference someone just made? Ask\!

## **Online Guidelines**

1. **Be Respectful:** Be kind and assume good will, use preferred pronouns, and only comment on people's projects if they explicitly ask for feedback. Respect the virtual makerspace and staff by keeping conversations appropriate and channels aligned with their intended purpose.  
2. **Ask Questions:** The greatest resource a Makerspace offers is fellow Makers. Don’t be afraid to ask staff or members about their builds or for help with your own projects.
